# Weather Observation Journal Starter

Subject: Science
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Observation Journal
NYS framework label: New York State P-12 Science Learning Standards

## Short Description
A primary observation page for recording weather, drawing evidence, and making simple claims.

## Alignment Note
Supports weather patterns, observation, evidence, and age-appropriate science communication.

## Classroom Use Case
Use during a two-week weather unit as a daily science notebook routine.

## Preview Content
- Today I notice
- My drawing evidence
- I predict tomorrow will be

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
